intro.text: A squadleader in Highmarshal Amaram's army.

items.text: Gare rose to squadleader in Amaram's army and named Nalem and Korabet his sergeants, who often went about with him. When the new recruit Cenn was placed in his squad, Kaladin bribed Gare with spheres to transfer the boy to his own.

appearance.text: A beefy man with a thick black beard who fights with an axe rather than a spear. A section of his scalp is missing on the right side, probably lost in battle.

personality.text: Stubborn and belligerent, he resents how everyone listens to Kaladin and dislikes taking his bribes, but his greed wins out. Kaladin thinks him so incompetent he might as well be fighting for the enemy.
